# LeadHealth

> A marketplace where health insurance agents and agencies buy and sell ACA, Medicare and Final Expense consumer leads. Every lead is scored 0–100, TCPA consent is recorded, and Do Not Call requests are enforced.

Website: https://www.leadhealth.co

## What LeadHealth does

LeadHealth connects agents who generate consumer leads with agents and agencies who want to buy them. Each lead is a consumer who asked about health insurance coverage: ACA/Obamacare, Medicare, or Final Expense life insurance.

## How it works

**Buyers**
- Create an account and add prepaid credits (online card payments are not yet available; credits are added by LeadHealth on request).
- Browse the marketplace and filter by coverage type, state and price.
- Before purchase, a listing shows the lead score, state, coverage interest, birth year, approximate income and TCPA consent status. Name and contact details are hidden.
- After purchase, the buyer sees the full name, phone, email, ZIP and date of birth, can keep private notes, and can export their leads to CSV.
- Each listing is sold to one buyer and is removed from the market once bought.

**Sellers**
- Submit a lead with the consumer's details, attest that TCPA consent was obtained, and set an asking price ($1–$500).
- The lead is scored automatically and listed on the marketplace.

## Lead score

Each lead is scored 0–100 from seven factors:

| Factor | Max points |
|---|---|
| TCPA consent | 25 |
| Coverage type requested | 20 |
| Age fit for that coverage | 15 |
| Recency of capture | 15 |
| State demand | 10 |
| Income fit | 8 |
| Record completeness | 7 |

Tiers: PRIME (80+), GOOD (60–79), FAIR (40–59), LOW (under 40). Lead freshness decays 2% per hour after capture, to a floor of 30%.

## Compliance

- Sellers must attest to TCPA consent before a lead can be listed; the consent source is stored with the lead.
- Leads on the Do Not Call list cannot be purchased.
- Consumers can opt out at https://www.leadhealth.co/opt-out. Matching leads are marked Do Not Call and taken off the market.
- LeadHealth is a private company and is not affiliated with any government agency.
